address: 89 Aro Street, Aro Valley, Wellington, 6021, New Zealand
bio: The indecisive or the easily envious will be pleased to know only a three-course set menu decided by the chef is served at this homely spot – but it does change every service. What doesn’t change is the high quality of the ingredients used, whether that’s the kingfish which is grilled and could come with coconut and lemongrass, or the duck used in tortellini. The restaurant, named after the chef’s grandmother, is housed in a cute old cottage. There are two sittings in the evening – but do book well in advance.
